description:
Get Brand Radar mentions overview: how often the property's brand appears in AI-assistant answers (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) across all tracked prompts for the date range. Returns total_prompts and three mutually-exclusive buckets, each {count, percent}: mentioned (brand named prominently), mentioned_in_text (brand appears only in the answer body) and absent (not mentioned). Note: these are mention-*presence* buckets, not sentiment/tone. Accepts a date range as presets (last_7_days, last_28_days, last_3_months, last_year) or absolute dates (from/to in Y-m-d). Pass the property ID (UUID) or URL (sc-domain:...) from list_properties.

Cost: 3 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// Brand mention breakdown across tracked prompts over the last 28 days.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","range":"last_28_days"}
```

range.description: Date-range preset. Mutually exclusive with from/to; pass either range or both from and to.
